Feck Zembi - 59 - losing sight
Peter Saelens - 69 - Stomach cancer feared - Exray report awaited.
5 Addison Holiday - 51 - hard of hearing - without religious faith knelt down To-day for blessing.
5 Viota K. Wells - 40 - at Deaconess - Husband and five small children - gall-stone - pertinitis - liver - cancer threatened -
John Emenaker - 63 - internal cancer ..... two operations - Drs. hope- less - Enroled To-night perpetually - Rain
Mrs. Weber .
Stanley Doll -... Wonderful ....
Joseph Noceda - 45 - blood poison -

10 Nia Kath Mcclellan - Bn. Feb. 12 - defective back ... Drs. have very little hope - Father non Cath.
Backus Habib - 20 - no sacraments - Mother laments.
Layton Stanley Brayman - baptized Cath. - 32 - indifferent to wife and children - starting divorce.
